## MicrosoftEdgeClient interface

The Microsoft Edge client: one namespace per resource that has operations, plus the app's own commands. A client factory creates one from `microsoftEdgeContract` in the app's `/contract` entry. Its type carries the contract's resource table, [MicrosoftEdgeResources](./microsoft-edge_contract.microsoftedgeresources.md)<!-- -->, so references can be bound to it by resource; the brand has no runtime member.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface MicrosoftEdgeClient extends ClientBrand<MicrosoftEdgeResources>
```

**Extends:** [ClientBrand](./contracts.clientbrand.md)<!-- -->&lt;[MicrosoftEdgeResources](./microsoft-edge_contract.microsoftedgeresources.md)<!-- -->&gt;
